Choose one of the following options to support the project.
Hi! I\'m Freetime Maker, the creator of GeoWeather. I started this project because I wanted a weather app that is clean, fast, and respects user privacy above all else.
GeoWeather is 100% free, open-source, and has no ads or trackers. Your donations help cover API costs and support the ongoing development of this and other privacy-focused apps.
